description:
As a customer, I want to complete my order.

* The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

criteria.text: The user can finish checkout and see a confirmation.

cases.title: User finishes checkout and sees a confirmation
cases.preconditions: A <customer account that can reach checkout> is logged in. The cart contains <at least one item>. The tester has <any checkout details the application requires, e.g. delivery address / payment details> ready to enter.
steps: Open the cart for the logged-in customer.
Complete the checkout flow, entering <the required checkout details>.
cases.expected: Checkout finishes and a confirmation is displayed to the user. The exact confirmation text and contents are not specified in the story.
